contentPattern: One row per card. Cell 1: icon image (optional). Cell 2: rich text - heading + short description. Cell 3 (optional): link; when present the whole card becomes clickable and a round arrow CTA is shown. Icon renders at the bottom of the card.
reuseGuidance: Use for benefit/feature grids. Options: light and orange are color schemes; link-list renders compact title-plus-arrow link tiles; alt renders the cards as a dropdown selector when every card has a link (catalog placement). For stacked link rows use cards-links; for tall icon tiles use cards-tiles.
usageDescription: Grid of 3-4 benefit/feature cards (heading, short description, round icon at the bottom) on product pages; with links, a row of product cards with an arrow CTA.
